### 💡 User Story
As a(n) [user type/admin], I want to [action/behavior] so that [benefit/outcomes].

### 📝 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### 🎨 Visual & Mechanical Mockups
Describe the user interface flow, visual accents (gradients, glassmorphism), and animations (e.g. Framer Motion transitions, Recharts widgets).

### ⚙️ Backend Requirements
Detail if this requires new Mongoose schemas, Redis caching layers, Gemini prompts, or SSE real-time notifications.

### ❓ Alternative Solutions Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context or details about the feature request here.
